events.title: Merope w/ Shahzad Ismaily + David Wesley Golightly
events.why: Lithuanian folk songs refracted through ambient, kosmische, and minimalism — kankles and experimental guitar meet Shahzad Ismaily. Oakland's Golightly opens with solo piano from his debut album. A quietly transportive Mission nonprofit evening.

events.title: Ambrose Trataris: Daisy-Chain Star-Connection
events.why: World-premiere hybrid VR performance at Gray Area: contemporary dance, drag, motion capture, and queer worldbuilding staged in physical and virtual nightclubs. Go-go dancers mirrored by holograms, original scores by Bay Area trans artists. Pure Deliria2 wavelength.

events.price_note: Free to browse; items for purchase
events.title: Tippett Studio Fire Sale
events.why: Phil Tippett's legendary Berkeley SFX studio closes after 40 years with a three-day bankruptcy fire sale. Star Wars AT-AT models signed by Tippett, Jurassic Park artifacts, masks, storyboards — analog-to-digital cinema history up for grabs.

events.title: Berkeley Frog Fest
events.why: The first-ever Berkeley Frog Fest: a free art-and-science festival from UC Berkeley frog nerds, with live poison frogs, an amphibian art competition, frog origami, screen printing, an amphibioscope zodiac, and real frog facts. Salamanders too, because why not.

events.title: Xicana Moratorium Block Party
events.why: EastSide Arts Alliance's annual block party commemorates the 1970 Chicano Moratorium with DJ La Femme Papi, live music, screenprinting, facepainting, and food by Tacos Mi Barrio. Nearly a decade of East Oakland community tradition honoring immigrant resistance.

events.title: It Is Not in Heaven: A Talmudic Argument About an Oven and the Case Against Letting AI Decide
events.why: A lunch talk that reads a famous Talmudic refusal of a heavenly voice as an early rejection of letting a perfect oracle settle legal questions, then asks what it teaches as courts hand judgment to AI. No background in Talmud or AI assumed. RSVP required.

events.title: CROSSROADS 2026: SF Cinematheque Experimental Film Festival
events.why: SF Cinematheque's 17th annual experimental film festival at Gray Area: 49 works by 52 artists across 22 countries in 8 programs. JG Thirlwell performs live to Harry Smith's occult classic Heaven and Earth Magic. The most expansive experimental-media showcase in the country.

events.title: Agentworld x Superdark Factory: Antikythera x Disintegrator
events.why: Benjamin Bratton (The Stack, Antikythera) and Marek Poliks deliver a double-lecture on how trillions of AI agents and fully automated agentic systems will reconfigure society. Planetary computation philosophy meets speculative governance — critical techno-futures at Gray Area.

events.title: SF Electronic Music Festival Night 1: Rrose, Idhaz, Blevin Blectum
events.why: SFEMF's 25th anniversary opens at The Lab with Rrose (experimental techno for multichannel sound), IDHAZ and Emily Bouton (electronics and violin), and Blevin Blectum of Blectum from Blechdom. Three decades of Bay Area experimental electronic lineage in one night.

events.title: Unseen Visions: A New Age Music and Culture Symposium
events.why: A two-day Gray Area symposium on New Age music and culture: Robert Rich and Steven Halpern perform live, Erik Davis (TechGnosis) and Jacob Smith present, plus screenings of Jordan Belson and Dorothy Fadiman visionary films. Media archaeology of a maligned but visionary genre.
